check3_signal._note: nav_rms_over_sigma: complex rms over readout of navigator echo m (1..L) divided by noise; kecho: rms over rows acquired at echo m, centre 64 readout samples; image_snr_like = mean of gaussian(sigma=3) magnitude inside mask / std outside mask.

check5_rf_pulses.clip_note: Frames are all normalized to peak 2047, so peak drive = mul. Largest mul: v182 refocus 180 (rfnum 1, same shape) = 1098. TX gain units not defined in repo; relative amplitude per 74 units unknown.

check7_frequency_offset_slices.note: dz = df*w/B; B is the nominal integer PPL bandwidth (1109 / 1283 Hz, handoff: exact 1109.375 / 1283.333). Imaging slice assumed 1 mm (reexc/imaging, B 1283). Overlap is a rectangular model; profile margins from docs/v182_v1912/validation/rf_margin.md added per side.
